cashPolicy: Gross USD. Actual cash received by target stays at zero yield, no interest/reinvestment/tax/fee assumptions. Non-USD requires a separately registered FX policy; unsupported here.
clockPolicy: KnownAt strictly before evaluation, quotes at the exact target timestamp, no forward carry or later settlement at an earlier horizon. Explicit supersession for corrections. No invented exchange calendar, session timestamp or original availability.
coveragePolicy: Complete provider-evidenced corporate-action, distribution, identity and terminal-status coverage for every held asset segment; dated notices cannot attest completeness.
holdingsPolicy: Permanent issue IDs only. Explicit per-unit settled cash/equity/right legs. Successor units retain linkage to the original cohort row. Splits and distributions are explicit, preventing adjusted-price double counting.
limitations: Initial historical cohort coverage still 0/34; no real outcome is computed.
WBA terms remain an unresolved diagnostic observation.

Only exact normalized gross USD entitlements supported. Account-specific election/rounding, tax, fees, FX, market-valued unresolved rights or unsequenced simultaneous corporate actions require additional evidence/policy; never guessed.
Original PIT/FJA bundles and previous experiments remain frozen. No production wiring, scheduler, provider purchase or new model evaluation.
metricPolicy: Separate explicit total-return-factor forecasts from original-issue split-adjusted price-factor forecasts. Total return MAE and direction recall retain zero terminal wealth. Full-population original-price MAPE is unavailable if any original issue is extinguished, missing, or has a zero price denominator. No survivor-only comparison and no automatic conversion of old model predictions.
originPolicy: One unit at the last origin-known completed unadjusted USD close, using the existing complete PIT cohort. Account from that quote timestamp through an explicit target session timestamp. Future corporate actions never select the origin cohort.
purpose: Account for evidenced shareholder wealth after mergers without manufacturing an original-security price target or promoting incomplete historical data.

references.role: General background; not used as security-level numeric evidence
Frozen actual WBA closing notice, unresolved contingent rights

settlementPolicy: Actual completed settlement evidence required independently of announcement/effective dates. effectiveAt must be the evidenced per-unit entitlement time; fractional and cash-in-lieu entitlements must already be normalized and verified. Post-target payments remain unvalued receivables and block returns.
unresolvedPolicy: Missing prices, identity, distributions, coverage, settlement or residual rights retain the row with a null outcome and block cohort return metrics. Delisting alone never means -100%. Zero requires documented cancellation/no residual rights.
